env.name: SPATIALPACK_MCP_SANDBOX
env.description: Sandbox root for asset reads and writes, equivalent to --sandbox. Defaults to a per-process temp directory.

env.name: SPATIALPACK_MCP_LOG
env.description: Log level for the JSON-Lines diagnostic stream on stderr: debug, info, warn, error, or silent. Defaults to info.
